state="title"
FX0=6
FY0=20
FX1=122
FY1=114
FA={0.5,0,0.75,0.25}

function reset()
 p={x=56,y=90,face=2,lives=3,inv=0,atk=0,ahit=false}
 b={x=50,y=26,hp=12,mx=12,st="idle",t=20,kind=1,count=0,ax=0,ay=1,wave=0,flash=0,tx=50}
 bullets={}
 parts={}
 ticks=0
 shake=0
 hitstop=0
 sfx(-1,3)
 music(0,200,7)
end

function _init()
 state="title"
 reset()
end

function rect_hits(x,y,w,h,a,c,aw,ah)
 return x<a+aw and a<x+w and y<c+ah and c<y+h
end

function cprint(t,y,c)
 print(t,64-#t*2,y,c)
end

function spawn_parts(x,y,n,col)
 for i=1,n do
  if #parts<24 then
   add(parts,{x=x,y=y,dx=rnd(3)-1.5,dy=rnd(3)-1.5,life=10+rnd(8),col=col})
  end
 end
end

function finish(won)
 state=won and "win" or "over"
 bullets={}
 sfx(-1,3)
 music(-1,200)
 if won then sfx(3,3) else sfx(4,3) end
end

function aim_track()
 local cx=b.x+8
 local cy=b.y+8
 local dx=(p.x+4)-cx
 local dy=(p.y+4)-cy
 local d=sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy)
 if d<1 then d=1 end
 b.ax=dx/d
 b.ay=dy/d
end

function update_player()
 if p.inv>0 then p.inv-=1 end
 local spd=2
 if p.atk>0 then
  p.atk-=1
  spd=1.2
  if p.atk>=5 and p.atk<=9 and p.ahit==false and swing_hits() then
   p.ahit=true
   hit_boss()
  end
 end
 local dx=(btn(1) and 1 or 0)-(btn(0) and 1 or 0)
 local dy=(btn(3) and 1 or 0)-(btn(2) and 1 or 0)
 if dx!=0 or dy!=0 then
  if dx<0 then p.face=0
  elseif dx>0 then p.face=1
  elseif dy<0 then p.face=2
  else p.face=3 end
  if dx!=0 and dy!=0 then dx*=0.7 dy*=0.7 end
  p.x=mid(FX0,p.x+dx*spd,FX1-8)
  p.y=mid(FY0,p.y+dy*spd,FY1-8)
 end
 if btnp(4) and p.atk<=0 then
  p.atk=14
  p.ahit=false
  sfx(16,3)
 end
end

function swing_hits()
 local cx=p.x+4
 local cy=p.y+4
 if p.face==0 then return rect_hits(cx-26,cy-7,24,14,b.x,b.y,16,16) end
 if p.face==1 then return rect_hits(cx+2,cy-7,24,14,b.x,b.y,16,16) end
 if p.face==2 then return rect_hits(cx-7,cy-26,14,24,b.x,b.y,16,16) end
 return rect_hits(cx-7,cy+2,14,24,b.x,b.y,16,16)
end

function hit_boss()
 b.hp-=1
 b.flash=8
 hitstop=3
 shake=2
 spawn_parts(b.x+8,b.y+8,6,10)
 sfx(18,3)
 if b.hp<=0 then
  b.hp=0
  spawn_parts(b.x+8,b.y+8,16,8)
  finish(true)
 end
end

function hurt_player()
 if state!="play" then return end
 if p.inv>0 then return end
 p.lives-=1
 p.inv=60
 hitstop=8
 shake=6
 spawn_parts(p.x+4,p.y+4,10,8)
 sfx(2,3)
 local dx=(p.x+4)-(b.x+8)
 local dy=(p.y+4)-(b.y+8)
 local d=sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy)
 if d<1 then d=1 end
 p.x=mid(FX0,p.x+dx/d*16,FX1-8)
 p.y=mid(FY0,p.y+dy/d*16,FY1-8)
 if p.lives<=0 then
  p.lives=0
  finish(false)
 end
end

function check_boss_contact()
 if state!="play" then return end
 if p.inv>0 then return end
 if rect_hits(b.x,b.y,16,16,p.x,p.y,8,8) then hurt_player() end
end

function start_idle()
 b.st="idle"
 b.t=18
 b.tx=rnd(80)+12
 b.wave=0
end

function start_tele()
 b.kind=1+b.count%2
 b.count+=1
 b.st="tele"
 b.t=24
 b.wave=0
 b.flash=0
 aim_track()
 sfx(17,3)
end

function start_active()
 b.st="act"
 if b.kind==1 then
  b.t=26
  shake=3
  sfx(19,3)
 else
  b.t=32
  b.wave=0
  sfx(20,3)
 end
end

function fire_wave()
 local cx=b.x+8
 local cy=b.y+8
 local base=0.125+b.wave/12
 for k=-2,2 do
  if #bullets<24 then
   local a=base+k/24
   add(bullets,{x=cx,y=cy,dx=cos(a)*1.9,dy=sin(a)*1.9})
  end
 end
 sfx(21,3)
end

function update_active()
 if b.kind==1 then
  b.x=b.x+b.ax*5
  b.y=b.y+b.ay*5
  b.t-=1
  if ticks%2==0 then spawn_parts(b.x+8-b.ax*10,b.y+8-b.ay*10,1,12) end
  if b.x<FX0 or b.y<FY0 or b.x>FX1-16 or b.y>FY1-16 then
   b.x=mid(FX0,b.x,FX1-16)
   b.y=mid(FY0,b.y,FY1-16)
   b.st="rec"
   b.t=30
   b.flash=10
   shake=5
   sfx(18,3)
  elseif b.t<=0 then
   b.st="rec"
   b.t=20
  end
 else
  if b.t%8==0 and b.wave<4 then
   fire_wave()
   b.wave+=1
  end
  b.t-=1
  if b.t<=0 then
   b.st="rec"
   b.t=24
  end
 end
end

function update_boss()
 if b.flash>0 then b.flash-=1 end
 if b.st=="idle" then
  if b.x<b.tx then b.x=min(b.x+0.4,b.tx) elseif b.x>b.tx then b.x=max(b.x-0.4,b.tx) end
  if b.y<26 then b.y=min(b.y+0.6,26) elseif b.y>26 then b.y=max(b.y-0.6,26) end
  b.t-=1
  if b.t<=0 then start_tele() end
 elseif b.st=="tele" then
  if b.kind==1 then
   if b.t>12 then aim_track() end
   if b.t==12 then sfx(17,3) end
  else
   if b.x<56 then b.x=min(b.x+1,56) elseif b.x>56 then b.x=max(b.x-1,56) end
   if b.y<26 then b.y=min(b.y+1,26) end
  end
  b.t-=1
  if b.t<=0 then start_active() end
 elseif b.st=="act" then
  update_active()
 else
  b.t-=1
  if b.t<=0 then start_idle() end
 end
 check_boss_contact()
end

function update_bullets()
 for i=#bullets,1,-1 do
  local bl=bullets[i]
  bl.x+=bl.dx
  bl.y+=bl.dy
  if bl.x<FX0-8 or bl.x>FX1+8 or bl.y<FY0-8 or bl.y>FY1+8 then
   deli(bullets,i)
  elseif p.inv<=0 and rect_hits(bl.x-3,bl.y-3,6,6,p.x,p.y,8,8) then
   deli(bullets,i)
   hurt_player()
  end
 end
end

function update_parts()
 for i=#parts,1,-1 do
  local q=parts[i]
  q.x+=q.dx
  q.y+=q.dy
  q.dx*=0.92
  q.dy*=0.92
  q.life-=1
  if q.life<=0 then deli(parts,i) end
 end
end

function _update()
 ticks+=1
 if state=="title" then
  if btnp(4) then
   reset()
   state="play"
   sfx(0,3)
  end
  return
 end
 if state=="win" or state=="over" then
  if btnp(4) then
   reset()
   state="play"
   sfx(0,3)
  end
  if btnp(5) then
   state="title"
   music(-1,200)
   sfx(-1,3)
  end
  return
 end
 if shake>0 then shake-=0.4 end
 if hitstop>0 then
  hitstop-=1
  return
 end
 update_player()
 update_boss()
 update_bullets()
 update_parts()
end

function draw_field()
 rectfill(FX0,FY0,FX1,FY1,1)
 rect(FX0-1,FY0-1,FX1+1,FY1+1,5)
 for i=1,7 do
  for j=1,5 do
   pset(FX0+i*15,FY0+j*15,13)
  end
 end
end

function draw_tele()
 local cx=b.x+8
 local cy=b.y+8
 if b.kind==1 then
  local c=b.t>12 and 10 or 8
  local px=-b.ay
  local py=b.ax
  for i=1,16 do
   local ox=cx+b.ax*i*6
   local oy=cy+b.ay*i*6
   if ox>FX0-6 and ox<FX1+6 and oy>FY0-6 and oy<FY1+6 then
    if (i+flr(ticks/3))%2==0 then
     rectfill(flr(ox)-1,flr(oy)-1,flr(ox)+1,flr(oy)+1,c)
    end
    pset(flr(ox+px*8),flr(oy+py*8),c)
    pset(flr(ox-px*8),flr(oy-py*8),c)
   end
  end
 else
  for k=-2,2 do
   local a=0.125+k/24
   line(flr(cx),flr(cy),flr(cx+cos(a)*76),flr(cy+sin(a)*76),flr(ticks/4)%2==0 and 9 or 8)
  end
 end
end

function draw_boss()
 if b.st=="tele" then draw_tele() end
 if b.hp<=0 then return end
 if b.st=="act" and b.kind==1 then
  for i=1,3 do
   local ox=b.x+8-b.ax*i*7
   local oy=b.y+8-b.ay*i*7
   rectfill(flr(ox)-3,flr(oy)-3,flr(ox)+3,flr(oy)+3,i+5)
  end
 end
 if b.flash>0 then
  pal(5,7,1) pal(6,7,1) pal(8,7,1) pal(9,7,1)
 elseif b.st=="tele" then
  pal(6,8,1) pal(5,4,1)
 elseif b.st=="rec" and flr(ticks/4)%2==0 then
  pal(6,7,1)
 end
 local x=flr(b.x)
 local y=flr(b.y)
 spr(32,x,y)
 spr(33,x+8,y)
 spr(34,x,y+8)
 spr(35,x+8,y+8)
 pal()
end

function draw_slash(cx,cy,ang)
 for i=0,6 do
  local a=ang-0.06+i*0.02
  local r=10+i*2
  local px=flr(cx+cos(a)*r)
  local py=flr(cy+sin(a)*r)
  if i%2==0 then
   rectfill(px-2,py-2,px+2,py+2,7)
  else
   rectfill(px-1,py-1,px+1,py+1,10)
  end
 end
end

function draw_player()
 local x=flr(p.x)
 local y=flr(p.y)
 if p.inv>0 and flr(p.inv/3)%2==0 then return end
 spr(4,x,y)
 if state=="play" and p.atk>=5 and p.atk<=9 then
  draw_slash(x+4,y+4,FA[p.face+1])
 end
end

function draw_bullets()
 for bl in all(bullets) do
  local x=flr(bl.x)
  local y=flr(bl.y)
  circfill(x,y,2,9)
  circfill(x,y,1,10)
 end
end

function draw_parts()
 for q in all(parts) do
  local s=q.life>8 and 2 or 1
  rectfill(flr(q.x),flr(q.y),flr(q.x)+s,flr(q.y)+s,q.col)
 end
end

function banner(txt,c)
 rectfill(14,50,113,80,0)
 rect(14,50,113,80,5)
 cprint(txt,58,c)
 cprint("o:retry x:title",68,7)
end

function draw_hud()
 for i=1,3 do
  if i<=p.lives then
   spr(7,2+(i-1)*10,4)
  else
   pal(8,5,1)
   spr(7,2+(i-1)*10,4)
   pal()
  end
 end
 print("boss",32,5,6)
 for i=1,b.mx do
  rectfill(52+(i-1)*5,6,55+(i-1)*5,11,i<=b.hp and 8 or 5)
 end
end

function draw_state_text()
 local msg=""
 local c=6
 if b.st=="tele" then
  msg=b.kind==1 and "warning: charge" or "warning: sweep"
  c=10
 elseif b.st=="act" then
  msg=b.kind==1 and "charging" or "sweeping"
  c=8
 elseif b.st=="rec" then
  msg="stunned - slash!"
  c=11
 end
 if msg!="" then cprint(msg,117,c) end
end

function _draw()
 cls(0)
 local sx=0
 local sy=0
 if shake>0 then
  sx=rnd(3)-1.5
  sy=rnd(3)-1.5
 end
 camera(sx,sy)
 draw_field()
 if state=="title" then
  rectfill(12,46,115,96,0)
  rect(12,46,115,96,5)
  cprint("boss duel",52,10)
  cprint("arrows:move",64,7)
  cprint("o:slash",74,7)
  cprint("beat it to win",84,8)
  draw_boss()
  draw_player()
 else
  draw_bullets()
  draw_boss()
  draw_player()
  draw_parts()
  draw_state_text()
  if state=="win" then
   banner("boss down",10)
  elseif state=="over" then
   banner("you fell",8)
  end
 end
 camera()
 draw_hud()
 if state=="title" and flr(ticks/12)%2==0 then cprint("press o",104,10) end
end
title: BOSS DUEL 单屏首领战

design.core_action: 方向键在单屏竞技场里走位，躲开冲锋轨迹与扇形弹幕，并用O朝面向方向挥出短程剑气命中Boss。
design.goal: 打掉Boss的12格血即获胜；3条命耗尽则失败。胜负后按O重开，X回标题。
design.risk: 挥剑时移速降到1.2、剑气只有约26像素且第5-9帧才有判定，靠近Boss才有输出；碰触Boss本体或弹幕都会掉命并进入2秒无敌闪烁。每招只有预告/行动/硬直三段，硬直才是安全输出期（Boss闪白）。
design.controls: 方向键8向移动（斜向0.7归一化），O挥剑/标题开始/结算重开，X在结算返回标题。
design.scenes: 单屏竞技场(6,20)-(122,114)与顶部HUD；状态title/play/win/over，均在同一屏。
design.audiovisual: Kajam社区BGM music(0,200,7)占声道0-2，声道3给操作与预警音；自定义SFX16挥剑、17预警(锁定帧再响一次)、18Boss受击/撞墙、19冲锋、20扫射起手、21每波弹幕；Boss为32-35四格16x16精灵，预告画虚线冲锋走廊与扇形射线，行动期冲锋带残影拖点，硬直期Boss闪白，受击有震动与粒子。
preserve: 方向键移动、O确认/攻击、X返回的既有按键约定
内置精灵1-12与内置音效0-5槽位
顶部HUD(心形生命)与竞技场内边距
unresolved: 预告24帧(约0.8秒)与Boss血量12是否合适、剑气判定宽度是否手感过窄，需实际试玩
扫射弹速1.9与扇形角度(±30°、每波30°)的疏密是否过松或过严，待试玩
冲锋锁定后0.4秒的反应窗口对新手是否偏紧
